sources.title: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B official model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The exact pinned developer card names Qwen2.5-32B (Base, not Instruct) as the student base and describes fine-tuning on DeepSeek-R1-generated samples. It notes generic config/tokenizer adjustments across the distill family; the exact 32B config freshly compared with its base is identical. No pruning, expert expansion or added modality is described.

sources.title: DeepSeek-R1 release announcement, January 20, 2025
sources.evidence: Explicitly dated January 20, 2025; announces simultaneous release of six distilled models, including the 32B model, with the R1 release.

sources.title: Pinned official Qwen-32B distill configuration
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved October 27, 2026 and compared with the official Qwen2.5-32B Base config. Full parsed JSONs are identical: Qwen2ForCausalLM, 64 layers, hidden 5120, intermediate 27648, 40 query/8 KV heads, vocabulary 152064 and untied embeddings. This confirms preserved parameter-bearing dimensions; no weight shards were read in this pass.

sources.title: Pinned complete checkpoint shard index
sources.evidence: Maps 771 tensor names to eight safetensors shards. Every indexed tensor was matched exactly once against bounded HTTP 206 header reads at this revision; no full weight shards were downloaded.

sources.title: Released checkpoint MIT license
sources.evidence: The exact checkpoint repository distributes an MIT license bearing DeepSeek copyright; the model card explicitly applies MIT to weights.

sources.title: Underlying Qwen2.5-32B Apache-2.0 license
sources.evidence: The identified base model carries Apache License 2.0; this provenance is also explicitly acknowledged in DeepSeek's model card.

sources.title: Pinned tokenizer and chat template
sources.evidence: Text conversation template starts generation with <think> and strips earlier thinking spans. It serializes tool-call and tool-result messages, but supplies no exact-checkpoint claim or evaluation establishing learned tool-use capability.

sources.title: DeepSeek-R1 original technical report, section 2.4
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Section 2.4 explicitly describes supervised fine-tuning of the named Qwen2.5-32B base using about 800k teacher-generated samples, without an RL stage. Distillation here transfers teacher outputs into an existing student; it is not structural pruning of the full R1 model.

sources.title: DeepSeek-R1 revised technical report, January 2026
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Appendix B.4.3 Table 6 maps the exact distill to Qwen2.5-32B and specifies fine-tuning for 2–3 epochs; Appendix F reiterates SFT-only distillation and compares its benchmark scores. Activated counts in this report concern full R1/V3, so the nominal student count is instead supported through the base developer’s table and documented lineage.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-32B official base model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The official card identifies the pretraining-stage Qwen2.5-32B base and its 64-layer, 40/8-head dense architecture. Its rounded 32.5B total and 31.0B non-embedding labels are not substituted for the exact distilled checkpoint total or the later explicit activated count.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report: base and distill activated-parameter comparison tables
sources.evidence: Read October 27, 2026. Table 4 explicitly reports 32B activated parameters for Qwen2.5-32B Base. Tables 15 and 17 also list exact DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B at 32B activated; these downstream comparison rows corroborate the base-lineage inference. Use the developer’s nominal activation convention, not exact total or non-embedding equality.

sources.title: Official Qwen2.5-32B Base configuration
sources.evidence: Freshly fetched October 27, 2026. Its full parsed JSON is identical to the pinned official DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B configuration, including layer count, hidden/FFN sizes, attention heads, vocabulary and untied embedding setting. Confirms no size-bearing change in the documented student fine-tuning relationship.

name.note: Exact official checkpoint name; distinct from May 2025 DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B.

developer.note: DeepSeek released the distill; Qwen is the developer of its base model.

family.note: Retains the catalog family key as a taxonomy mapping to the documented DeepSeek-R1 reasoning/distillation family.

release_date.note: The dated first-party release announces the six distilled checkpoints alongside R1; the exact model card identifies the 32B member.

open_weights.note: The official repository publishes all eight checkpoint shards and their index.

license.note: Released distill weights are MIT; the underlying Qwen2.5-32B base is Apache-2.0. Preserve base-license provenance rather than describe MIT as replacing upstream obligations.

parameters_b.note: Complete learned checkpoint count: 32,763,876,352 = sum of all 771 BF16 tensor shape products. All indexed names match once. No buffers or quantization metadata are counted. Input embedding and lm_head each contain 778,567,680 distinct parameters; tie_word_embeddings=false, so neither is deduplicated. Independent config formula: 2*152064*5120 + 64*(2*5120^2 + 2*5120*1024 + 3*5120*27648 + 2*5120 + 5120 + 2*1024) + 5120. The name's 32B is nominal. October 27 re-audit retains this prior complete census and reconfirms the configuration; no weight shards were downloaded again.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal 32B activated parameters, inferred from the explicit Qwen2.5-32B Base fine-tuning lineage and identical parameter-bearing configuration. Qwen’s later report Table 4 defines 32B active for that base; Tables 15 and 17 corroborate the exact distill at 32B active. Teacher-output distillation does not prune the student architecture. No structural expansion or modality change is described. This follows the published nominal convention rather than equating active parameters with the precise 32.763876352B total or a non-embedding count.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Qwen2 causal Transformer: 64 layers, GQA (40 query/8 KV heads), SwiGLU and RMSNorm. Config and complete checkpoint have no routed experts.

context_window.note: Exact released config sets max_position_embeddings=131072. The card's vLLM example limits serving to 32768 and evaluations cap generation at 32768; these are not the configured position limit. No claim that all 131072 positions were benchmark-validated is inferred.

modalities.note: Text-token causal language model and text chat template; complete checkpoint contains no image/audio encoders or decoders.

reasoning.note: Exact distill is trained and evaluated for reasoning; its shipped generation template opens a <think> span. This is not an inferred May-0528 hybrid-mode feature.

tool_call.note: Baseline false is not established for this exact checkpoint by a first-party capability statement. The shipped template accepts tool calls/results, but serialization is insufficient to establish reliable tool-use support. Full R1 API limitations and later releases are not transferred to this distill.

description.value: Dense text reasoning model fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-32B using about 800,000 samples curated with DeepSeek-R1.
description.note: Replaces the broad efficiency wording with the documented base, model type and distillation procedure.

patch.description: Dense text reasoning model fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-32B using about 800,000 samples curated with DeepSeek-R1.
patch.notes: January 2025 R1 distill of Qwen2.5-32B. Complete BF16 checkpoint: 32,763,876,352 learned parameters; untied input/output embeddings are both included. Nominal 32B active is inferred from the documented Qwen2.5-32B Base fine-tuning lineage and matching configuration, using Qwen’s activated-parameter convention. MIT release derives from an Apache-2.0 base. Context 131,072 is the configured position limit; the official example/evaluation uses 32,768. Tool-call formatting exists, but exact-variant tool-use capability remains unverified.

sources.label: Qwen3 Technical Report: base and distill activated-parameter comparison tables

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit preserves the prior precise 32.763876352B total and recovers nominal 32B active from explicit Qwen2.5-32B Base fine-tuning lineage, identical fresh configurations and Qwen’s activated-parameter tables. Original and revised DeepSeek reports establish student fine-tuning rather than structural pruning; exact-distill rows in the later Qwen report corroborate the inference. All unrelated field assessments are preserved; no weight shards were downloaded.
